mapper.select: SELECT contact_id AS fromId, username AS name, avatarurl FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN from_id = #{userId} THEN to_id ELSE from_id END AS contact_id, username, avatarurl, create_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN from_id = #{userId} THEN to_id ELSE from_id END ORDER BY create_time DESC) AS rn FROM message WHERE from_id = #{userId} OR to_id = #{userId} ) AS temp WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (from_id, to_id, type, content_id, content_type, username, avatarurl, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{fromId}, #{toId}, #{type}, #{contentId}, #{contentType}, #{username}, #{avatarurl}, NOW(), NOW())
